_comment: Single source of truth for every OTLP name the KYA dashboards may query. OSS entries are read from src/otel/exporter.ts and src/otel.ts and proven by test/fixtures/otlp-capture.json; hosted entries are read from the hosted Java plane (not part of this package) and are not in the fixture. scripts/validate-dashboards.mjs rejects any dashboard query that names something not listed here.

spans.notes: One zero-duration span per verdict. Long-lived processes (MCP gate, gateway) export every verdict; hook and wrap spawns export DENY and REQUIRE_APPROVE only (NOTIFYABLE_VERDICTS in src/notify/index.ts). DENY carries OTLP status ERROR.

attributes.name: kya.reason_code
attributes.notes: values is the subset dashboards may filter on, each a literal in src (test/dashboards.test.ts checks): NEVER_EVENT never-list hit (src/offline-evaluate.ts, src/commands/hook.ts), PLANE_UNREACHABLE and PLANE_AUTH_REJECTED MCP gate plane call failed (src/mcp/protocol.ts), FAIL_CLOSED opt-in fail-closed hook error (src/commands/hook.ts). The plane and offline evaluator emit other codes too.

attributes.name: kya.host
attributes.notes: gate host class, not the agent product

metrics.name: kya.client.evaluate.latency
metrics.notes: Recorded only when the CLI calls the hosted plane evaluate API (KYA_OTLP_ENDPOINT set) and the process lives past the 15 s export interval, in practice a connected MCP gate or gateway. Hooks evaluate offline and never emit it.

metrics.name: kya.evaluate.latency
metrics.notes: Micrometer timer; no buckets unless percentile histograms are enabled

metrics.name: kya.policy.deny
metrics.notes: cumulative count exposed as a gauge

metrics.name: kya.llm.latency
metrics.source: hosted plane: LlmMeterSupport (Micrometer timer, dispute-agent LLM calls)
metrics.notes: not a gate metric; no dashboard panel uses it
